title: A Cake for Dan
setting: A cozy kitchen with an open window on a gray day.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Aiko bakes a cake in her quiet kitchen.
sentences.zh: 爱子在安静的厨房里烤蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron mixes cake batter in a bowl in a calm, cozy kitchen.

sentences.en: It is important: today is Dan's birthday.
sentences.zh: 今天很重要：是丹的生日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron looks at a wall calendar with a big red heart drawn on it.

sentences.en: She bakes this special cake once every year.
sentences.zh: 这种特别的蛋糕她每年只烤一次。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron takes a special old cake tin from a high shelf.

sentences.en: She adds sugar, fruit and a glass of milk.
sentences.zh: 她加入糖、水果和一杯牛奶。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron pours a glass of milk into a bowl with sugar and fruit beside it.

sentences.en: Outside the open window, the sky is gray.
sentences.zh: 敞开的窗外，天空灰蒙蒙的。
sentences.scene_prompt: An open kitchen window shows a gray, cloudy sky; a cake cools on the sill.

sentences.en: Dan is late, but he usually comes early.
sentences.zh: 丹迟到了，可他通常都来得很早。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron waits by the finished cake, looking at the wall clock with a worried face.

sentences.en: Then she hears a sound: Dan is back!
sentences.zh: 接着她听到一个声音：丹回来了！
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron turns towards the opening front door as Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt steps in.

sentences.en: "My dear, your cakes are always nice," says Dan.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的，你做的蛋糕总是很好吃。”丹说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt eats a piece of cake and smiles at Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron at the kitchen table.
